checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are generally reasonable. The untestable checkpoints (mesh base, elastic bands) are correctly marked as such since they're occluded by the mannequin head. The testable checkpoints are appropriately marked as present, with good reasoning. However, I note that the Router was slightly lenient on the 'Synthetic fibers or human hair mounted on mesh base' checkpoint - while the wig appears to be synthetic fibers, the mesh base isn't actually visible, so this should perhaps be marked as partially testable or with lower confidence. The Router correctly identified that the wig conforms to cranial curvature, has realistic density, directional flow patterns, varied coloration, and wavy texture.
artifact_review: The Router identified two minor artifacts: a texture anomaly near the parting line (severity 1.5) and structural collapse at the wig edge near the mannequin neck (severity 1.0). These are reasonable observations. The texture anomaly is likely due to the manufactured nature of the wig rather than an AI artifact, but the Router correctly noted it. The structural collapse at the edge is also minor and likely due to the mounting. The experts did not report any additional artifacts - the perceptual quality auditor found no distortions, the topology boundary auditor found a clean mask with high confidence, and the geometric depth auditor found normal depth statistics. However, I note that the experts have limitations and may have missed subtle artifacts. The Router's severity ratings seem appropriate - these are minor issues that don't significantly impact the overall quality.
alignment_reasoning: 7 out of 7 testable checkpoints passed. The fine_grained_classifier strongly confirmed the class with 'wig' as top prediction (logit 8.09). The Router was slightly lenient on one checkpoint regarding the mesh base visibility, but overall the alignment is strong. The wig clearly matches the class definition in all visible aspects.
artifact_reasoning: Router identified two minor artifacts with low severity (1.5 and 1.0). Experts found no additional artifacts - perceptual quality was clean, topology boundary was intact, and depth was normal. The artifacts noted are likely due to the physical nature of the wig/mannequin rather than AI generation issues. The severity ratings are appropriate and the overall artifact level is low.
